dialect.detail: RM/COBOL dialect; SOURCE-COMPUTER and OBJECT-COMPUTER both set to RMCOBOL; uses RM/COBOL-style DISPLAY ... LINE ... POSITION and ACCEPT ... NO BEEP syntax; ASSIGN TO DISK with quoted path typical of RM/COBOL
evidence: ACCEPT DUR NO BEEP LINE 1 POSITION 1

purpose.domain_detail: Turkish financial/accounting application; program name CEKSENET likely means 'checks and promissory notes' (çek-senet); reads an indexed file of transaction records
purpose.summary: A small utility program that opens an indexed file (HAREKET-INDEX) containing transaction/document records and sequentially reads and displays each record, pausing for user input between records. It appears to be a simple browse/inspection tool for a checks-and-notes (çek-senet) ledger index file.

notable_features: RM/COBOL screen I/O: DISPLAY ... LINE POSITION and ACCEPT ... NO BEEP
INDEXED file with multiple ALTERNATE RECORD KEYs WITH DUPLICATES
ASSIGN TO DISK with DOS-style path (DATA\HARSIC.IDX)
Author name suggests Turkish origin (Fikret Pirim)
verdict.notes: Very short program (41 lines); appears to be a standalone browse utility or diagnostic tool rather than a full production program. The tab character in the FILE-CONTROL indentation is visible. The domain inference (banking/finance, checks and notes) is based on the Turkish word 'CEKSENET' (çek=check, senet=promissory note).
